csv_project_name: AE Services for CyRide Facility Steam Clean Bay
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Ames (City) CyRide s facility, located at 601 N. University Blvd, Ames, Iowa, has a single steam cleaning location for the maintenance of their heavy-duty transit bus fleet which consists of a parallelogram vehicle lift within a main travel lane inside the facility. CyRide received an Iowa Department of Transportation (DOT) Public Transportation Improvement Grant (PTIG) to update the steam clean bay and is seeking Architectural and Engineering services to design and provide technical assistance for construction portion of this project. The project will include replacing the existing parallelogram platform lift with a longer lift, replacing concrete to accept the new lift, relocating the sand / oil separator, improving lighting and replacing windows. The selected Firm will help develop plans and specifications, bid estimates, award and closeout recommendation letters, technical services during the construction phase, site visits and project closeout activities. The lift will be purchased in a separate procurement, which will include installing the lift once construction is complete.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Sanitation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
